parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A rubber wheel of the cart, cylindrical in shape, used for rolling movement.
parts.Functional_description: Provides traction and allows the cart to move smoothly on surfaces.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its axle to enable forward and backward motion.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A rear wheel of the cart made of rubber, providing stability and support.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the rear of the cart and contributes to smooth rolling motion.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its axle to assist in movement and turning.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A front wheel of the cart made of rubber, part of the steering mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: Helps steer and balance the cart during motion.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates and pivots slightly for directional control.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A rear wheel of the cart made of rubber, identical to the other rear wheel.
parts.Functional_description: Provides rear-end support and stability during movement.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its axle to maintain balance and motion.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A front wheel of the cart made of rubber, part of the steering system.
parts.Functional_description: Assists in steering and maintaining smooth forward motion.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates and pivots slightly for steering control.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the cart made of aluminum, including the frame, roof, and seating area.
parts.Functional_description: Supports all other components, provides seating for passengers, and structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: Stationary structure; does not move but supports moving parts like wheels and steering.
